base_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE complete portrait mobile idle racing game popup concept, 852x1846 pixels, aspect ratio 390:845. Use input image as STYLE REFERENCE, not a literal layout to reproduce. Premium soft miniature toy diorama art, ivory cream, bright sky blue, navy text, plush bevels, ambient occlusion, controlled gloss, readable bold Vietnamese. Dimmed recognizable harbor circuit racing game background, miniature cars, resource HUD, upgrade rows, bottom five tabs Shop / Túi / Đua / Đội / Giải, center Đua selected. No phone bezel or design annotations. One main cream modal about 350 logical pixels wide with thick rounded blue border, inset sky-blue content window with cream bevel and cream information cards, separate light-blue footer strip with seam.
CRITICAL REDESIGN: TITLE IS A PERFECTLY FLAT STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL BLUE ROUNDED RECTANGLE PLATE. Top and bottom edges are parallel horizontal straight lines across the middle 80 percent. No curved ribbon, arch, perspective, bulge, concavity, swoop or waving flags. Small checkered RECTANGULAR end caps only outside text safe area. Plain uniform blue or VERTICAL blue gradient middle, no illustration or motifs in middle, horizontally 9-slice stretchable. Title letters all have identical font size, upright, on ONE perfectly straight horizontal baseline, centered, white with a soft dark blue outline. Never wrap title. Make enough width for title. Plate overlaps modal top edge. Preserve rounded cream body and soft miniature depth elsewhere. Maximum one orange primary; secondary blue. Match reference materials. Do not bend title or plate.
